entries.claim: RG115a supplies the complete Father-directed Per Dominum ending for this prayer’s printed cue. The same-edition expanded stem and terminal-response typography control the supplied conclusion w025–w045 and distinct Amen w046, not the proper prayer body.

The Collect is the priest's prayer, audible in read Mass and sung in sung Mass; in the bounded sole separately concluded commemoration context it retains a conclusion distinct from the Mass Collect. This claim is not a rule for each member of larger groups.

entries.claim: This separate setting prints the 24-word proper body, w001–w024, and its literal cue. Separate setting corroborates the proper letters, accents and punctuation, which agree in these two settings. Both proper faces print the literal conclusion cue “Per Dóminum.” The cue is not the full supplied conclusion or Amen. Not independent historical transmission. The full conclusion and Amen are supplied separately from this setting’s RG115a, not from the proper face.
